tasks.answer:
Nykaa offers customer support through multiple channels:

1. **Chat Support** - Available on the homepage at the bottom right corner via a button labeled 'How may we help you' which opens a live chat widget (Messaging window/iframe).

2. **Help Center** - Accessible via the 'Help' link in the header navigation at: https://www.nykaa.com/gateway-api/omsApis/helpCenter?domain=NYKAA

These are the primary contact options I found on the website. Specific phone numbers and email addresses were not visible on the homepage but may be available within the Help Center page or through the chat support.
